product.name: Camlist
product.description: A mobile app that allows users to find and rehome pets through video listings, chat with breeders, and make secure payments directly within the app.

product.name: Video Listings
product.description: Feature that allows users to see videos of pets posted on the app and conduct live video calls with breeders.

product.name: Chat Safely
product.description: In-app chat feature that enables users to communicate securely with breeders.

product.name: Safe Payment
product.description: In-app payment system that ensures money is protected and offers a 0% financing option.
